content.short: Cosmocadia is a collaborative community-building game on Sui where users design and inhabit a digital world.
content.description: Cosmocadia is a unique decentralized social and creative game built on the Sui blockchain, empowering players to design, build, and govern their own digital landscapes. In this vibrant metaverse, users can own plots of land as NFTs and collaborate with others to create complex structures, participate in community events, and develop a thriving virtual economy. The game emphasizes digital ownership and player-driven creativity, where every asset and achievement is recorded on-chain. By leveraging Sui's high performance and advanced NFT capabilities, Cosmocadia offers a seamless and immersive experience that redefines the boundaries of social interaction and collaborative entertainment in the Web3 era.
content.meta: Cosmocadia is a collaborative community-building game on Sui, featuring digital land ownership and player-driven creativity in a vibrant metaverse.
